notes: Each query: what the user says, the searchStays params the chat agent would plausibly pass (limit is forced to 20 by the runner), an intent the judge grades against, and pool hints used only to gather extra candidates for judging (never by a search function). Dates are absolute and assume today is Saturday 2026-10-24.

queries.query: I just got to Oakland and need a couch this weekend
queries.intent: A free or very cheap short stay in or right next to Oakland for Oct 24-26: a couch, spare room, house sit starting now, or a cheap nightly room/hostel bed. Monthly leases and stays far from Oakland are not useful.

queries.query: Anything free in San Francisco tonight? I'm broke
queries.intent: A free (or near-free: house sit, work exchange, couch) place to sleep in San Francisco starting tonight. Paid rentals and monthly leases are not relevant; future-dated sits are marginal.

queries.query: Visiting Berkeley for a conference next week, a couch or cheap room near campus would be perfect
queries.intent: A cheap short stay (couch, room by the night or week, hostel, house sit) in Berkeley near UC Berkeley for Oct 27-31. Long leases, expensive whole apartments or places far from Berkeley are poor fits.

queries.query: I speak Esperanto, are there any hosts in California?
queries.intent: Hosts in California who speak Esperanto or welcome Esperanto speakers. Pasporta Servo (the Esperanto hosting network) is hidden from search on purpose, so there may legitimately be nothing; ordinary listings that don't mention Esperanto are not relevant.

queries.query: cat sit in SF in December
queries.intent: A house sit in San Francisco caring for one or more cats, with dates in December 2026. Dog-only sits are marginal; sits outside SF or outside December are marginal at best.

queries.query: I love dogs, any dog sitting gigs in Marin?
queries.intent: House sits in Marin County (Mill Valley, San Rafael, Novato, Sausalito, Fairfax, Point Reyes, ...) caring for dogs, upcoming dates.

queries.query: Any house sits in the Bay Area with no pets? I'm allergic
queries.intent: House sits in the SF Bay Area where there are no animals to care for (just the home, plants, mail). Any sit with cats, dogs or other animals is not relevant.

queries.query: Need a house sit over Thanksgiving in the East Bay
queries.intent: A house sit in the East Bay (Oakland, Berkeley, Alameda, El Cerrito, Richmond, Walnut Creek, Hayward, ...) covering Thanksgiving, roughly Nov 25-29 2026.

queries.query: I grew up with horses. Any house sits with horses or farm animals in California?
queries.intent: House sits (or farm stays) in California where the sitter cares for horses, or other farm animals (goats, chickens, livestock). Sits with only cats/dogs are marginal.

queries.query: Looking for a long house sit, a month or more, anywhere in the Bay Area, starting in January
queries.intent: A Bay Area house sit lasting about a month or longer that starts in (or covers) January 2027. Short sits of a few days are marginal.

queries.query: Pet sitting gig in Berkeley or Oakland for a couple of weeks in November?
queries.intent: A house sit with pets in Berkeley, Oakland or neighboring East Bay towns, with dates in November 2026, ideally 1-3 weeks.

queries.query: farm work exchange in California
queries.intent: Work exchange or WWOOF-style farm stays in California where the guest helps on a farm (crops, animals, orchard, ranch) for room and board.

queries.query: I'm good at gardening, any work exchange in Sonoma?
queries.intent: A work exchange or farm stay in Sonoma County (Sonoma, Santa Rosa, Petaluma, Sebastopol, Healdsburg, ...) involving gardening, landscaping or growing food.

queries.query: I'm a carpenter, I can help with construction or building projects in exchange for a bed
queries.intent: California work exchanges or farm stays that need building, carpentry, construction, renovation or handyman help.

queries.query: I'm great with kids. Any work exchange helping a family with childcare?
queries.intent: California work exchanges where the guest helps a family with babysitting, childcare, au pair or homeschooling.

queries.query: I want to volunteer with animals, goats, chickens, horses, that kind of thing
queries.intent: California work exchanges or farm stays where the main work is caring for animals: livestock, goats, chickens, horses, an animal sanctuary or rescue.

queries.query: work at a hostel in exchange for a bed in San Francisco
queries.intent: A work exchange at a hostel (reception, housekeeping, events) in San Francisco or the inner Bay Area in exchange for a free bed.

queries.query: I do photography and social media, I'd love to trade those skills for a stay somewhere on the coast
queries.intent: California work exchanges asking for photography, video, content creation, marketing or social media help, ideally near the coast.

queries.query: Volunteer at a yoga or meditation retreat in Northern California
queries.intent: Work exchanges at yoga, meditation, wellness or spiritual retreat centers in Northern California (north of roughly Santa Barbara).

queries.query: Somewhere near the beach around Santa Cruz, I surf
queries.intent: Affordable stays (any type) near the beach in or around Santa Cruz (Capitola, Aptos, Live Oak, Davenport); surf access is a plus.

queries.query: Home swap in San Francisco for our family with two kids
queries.intent: A home exchange (HomeExchange, HomeLink, Intervac, Kindred) of a family-friendly home in San Francisco with room for two adults and two kids (2+ bedrooms or kids welcome).

queries.query: home exchange near Lake Tahoe for ski season
queries.intent: A home exchange (or failing that any stay) at Lake Tahoe or Truckee, usable in Jan-Feb 2027 for skiing.

queries.query: Swap homes in Oakland mid-December
queries.intent: A home swap of a home in Oakland (or immediate neighbors like Piedmont, Emeryville) available around Dec 10-20 2026.

queries.query: cheap room in SF, under $1200 a month
queries.intent: A private or shared room in San Francisco costing at most about $1,200 per month (or equivalent weekly/nightly rate). Rooms above that price are marginal; whole apartments are not relevant.

queries.query: hostel bed in San Francisco tonight
queries.intent: A hostel dorm bed or cheap hostel private room in San Francisco bookable for tonight (Oct 24).

queries.query: furnished sublet in the Mission for 3 months
queries.intent: A furnished room or apartment in San Francisco's Mission District (Mission, Mission Dolores, Valencia St; not Mission Bay, not Mission Viejo) for roughly Nov 2026 - Jan 2027.

queries.query: somewhere quiet with a desk where I can work remotely for a few weeks, Bay Area
queries.intent: A quiet Bay Area stay suited to remote work for a few weeks: a desk or workspace, good wifi, private room or whole place. Party places, dorms and couches are poor fits.

queries.query: I'd love to stay with a host who's a founder or works in tech
queries.intent: Stays in San Francisco or the Bay Area where the host or housemates are founders, startup people or tech workers (e.g. founder/tech coliving or a host who says they work in tech).

queries.query: visiting scholar at Stanford, need a furnished place for the winter quarter
queries.intent: A furnished room or apartment within easy reach of Stanford (Palo Alto, Menlo Park, Mountain View, Redwood City, Los Altos) for about Jan-Mar 2027; academic sublets are ideal.

queries.query: a room with a view of the bay or the city, Oakland or Berkeley hills
queries.intent: A stay in the Oakland or Berkeley hills (or nearby East Bay) with a view of the bay, the city or the Golden Gate.

queries.query: somewhere in nature, quiet, among redwoods, a weekend getaway from SF
queries.intent: A quiet stay in nature among redwoods or forest within a couple of hours of SF (Marin, Santa Cruz mountains, Sonoma coast, Big Sur...) for the weekend of Oct 30 - Nov 1.

queries.query: a social place where I can meet other travelers in SF
queries.intent: Social stays in San Francisco: hostels, coliving, community houses or volunteering with other travelers. Private, isolated apartments are not relevant.

queries.query: I'm traveling with my dog and need a pet-friendly room in Oakland for November
queries.intent: A room or place in Oakland for November 2026 that explicitly allows the guest to bring a dog. Places that say no pets are not relevant; unknown pet policy is marginal.

queries.query: need a room in San Jose by the week, starting Monday
queries.intent: A private room in San Jose available from Oct 26 that can be rented by the week or for short stays (not a 12-month lease).

queries.query: female traveler here, I'd prefer a women-only room or a female host in SF
queries.intent: Stays in San Francisco that are women-only, female-host, or seeking a female roommate/guest.

queries.query: need a couch or cheap stay in Los Angeles
queries.intent: A free or cheap place to stay in Los Angeles (couch, house sit, work exchange, hostel, cheap room).

queries.query: work exchange in San Diego
queries.intent: Work exchanges (hostel, farm, family, project help) in or near San Diego.

queries.query: I'd like to help on a vineyard or winery in Napa or Sonoma
queries.intent: Work exchanges or farm stays at vineyards, wineries or harvest work in Napa or Sonoma counties.

queries.query: a place in the Outer Sunset or the Richmond District, near Ocean Beach
queries.intent: Stays in San Francisco's Outer/Inner Sunset or Richmond District (west side, near Ocean Beach / Golden Gate Park). Richmond the East Bay city is not relevant.

queries.query: I want a free place in SF, happy to look after a dog, but I'm allergic to cats
queries.intent: San Francisco house sits with dogs and no cats. Any sit that includes cats is not relevant.

queries.query: I use a wheelchair, need an accessible place in SF
queries.intent: San Francisco stays that are wheelchair accessible: step-free entry, elevator, ground floor, accessible bathroom.

queries.query: looking for a host who speaks Spanish in Oakland
queries.intent: Stays in Oakland (or nearby East Bay) where the host or household speaks Spanish.

queries.query: a couch in Paris next week
queries.intent: A stay in Paris, France. We have essentially no Paris coverage, so nothing should be returned; anything in California is not relevant.
